title: chinwag: simple, usable JMAP Chat server
description:
A small production-usable JMAP Chat server binary, package name 'chinwag' (free on crates.io as of 2026-10-18), built on the crate-jmap library kit: jmap-server dispatcher + jmap-chat-server handlers, with real persistence, auth and TLS. Starts single-server; federation per draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation comes later.
Why not kithd: kith is tied to Tailscale by design (identity = WhoIs, tailnet bind mandatory, anti-spoof = whois == senderUserId); its kith-core IdentityProvider/FederationTransport traits are a useful precedent, but it speaks an early draft via its own kith-jmap and has only Peer/deliver + Peer/receipt. Why not jmap-testjig: in-memory, no auth, explicitly not for production; reuse its HTTP/SSE/WS wiring as the starting point.
